title: Ôn tập review-first default, embed localized revenge widget, and redirect /cardgen

spec.problem: Visiting /{locale}/flashcards without a ?tab param currently defaults to the Library deck list even when the learner has due SRS cards; RevengeModeWidget is disconnected from Ôn tập and contains hardcoded mixed English/Vietnamese copy while silently swallowing fetch/submit errors; /{locale}/cardgen remains a standalone page duplicating AutoGenDialog in the Flashcards library.

acceptance.text: 1. /{locale}/flashcards with no explicit ?tab param (and no cloneToken/deckId) opens the Review tab directly when the existing /api/flashcards/reviews/due fetch returns due > 0 (without adding any new API calls), and opens Library when due === 0; explicit ?tab=review, ?tab=library, valid ?deckId, and ?cloneToken always win and manual tab selection is never overridden. 2. RevengeModeWidget is embedded at the top of the Review tab inside FlashcardsPageClient with all copy (title, subtitle, start CTA, loading status, error/retry, question counter, completion summary, close) localized via the flashcards namespace in vi/en/ja messages and WCAG-AA theme tokens, while remaining backward-compatible for callers passing only locale. 3. /{locale}/cardgen server-redirects to /{locale}/flashcards?tab=library under Strategy (a) (keeping cardgen-page-client.tsx on disk) and /cardgen stays excluded from sitemap.xml. 4. /review stays a separate route; web-only changes; theme-contrast regression and frontend-debt floors remain green untouched.

classification.rationale: Web-only Next.js App Router UI, i18n, and server redirect change across flashcards, RevengeModeWidget, and /cardgen with zero backend, schema, auth, or shared-package mutations.
